data.title: 空崎日奈 · 更衣室长凳的静谧整袜
data.description: 深夜空无一人的风纪委私人休息更衣室里，暖色小吸顶灯静静亮着。日奈赤脚坐在木质长凳边缘，微微低头整理着暗紫蕾丝吊袜带与薄黑过膝袜的贴合弧度。听见熟悉的敲门声时她手指微顿，抬头望向来人，眼底藏着既害羞又无比信赖的柔和。
data.location: 暖光安静的风纪委私人更衣室木长凳
data.action: 坐于木长凳低头整理黑丝袜扣，听见来人后微红双颊抬头
data.lighting: 室内柔暖顶灯勾勒暗紫蕾丝边与缎面光泽
data.camera: 平视中景，木长凳与半掩更衣柜构成私密空间感
data.mood: 安静、害羞、毫无戒备的依赖
data.promptProse: Seated barefoot on the wooden bench of her quiet private dressing room after hours, Hina pauses with her fingertips at the clasp of her sheer black thigh-high stockings. Warm indoor light traces the deep-purple lace trim of her black satin camisole as she looks up with a soft, trusting blush.
data.animaCaption: Sitting barefoot on the dressing-room bench, she pauses while adjusting her black thigh-highs and looks up with a soft blush.
data.nsfwProse: Delicate purple lace edging and tiny satin bows frame her camisole above the matching garter belt and sheer black stockings.
